item.title: Lady Raiders rack up Big 12 honors after historic season
item.description: With the regular season coming to a close, the Big 12 Conference unveiled its women's college basketball yearly awards Tuesday. The No. 21 Lady Raiders were represented throughout numerous categories following their most successful season in over two decades.

item.title: Details on missing 11-year-old have been released

item.title: Red Raiders' Senior Night spoiled by TCU
item.description: Texas Tech came into Tuesday night riding a three-game win streak and looked to keep things going in their final home game against TCU. However, the No. 10 Red Raiders were upended by the rival Horned Frogs 73-65 in a Senior Night spoiler.
